basic_info.description: Located in the vibrant heart of the Mission, Just 1 block from Dolores park, centrally located to all that SF has to offer, it does not get much better than this for location. Family owned for over 45 years. Owner owned the grocery store on the corner for a similar amount of time and now elderly and wants to cash out.  6 residential units and 3 commercial, but rent is only being collected on 2 of the commercial space.  The grocery store occupies 2 spaces but the rent is based on the corner space alone. A pride of ownership property that the seller is sad to let go. Some solid upside on this property!
